shared_elements: large predatory animal with prominent head shown frontally/in profile
small human-like figure subordinate to a larger creature
creatures stacked one above another in a vertical sequence
justification: Both surfaces present a vertically stacked hierarchy of creatures in which a large-headed predatory animal with splayed clawed limbs looms over a much smaller anthropomorphic figure, with a bird form included in the sequence, and both render bodies schematically with oversized heads and heavily emphasised limbs. The clearest difference is that A spreads its creatures as separate, loosely juxtaposed figures across a bounded panel below a horizontal register of repeated arm/hand and abstract motifs, whereas B fuses its figures into a single interlocking column in which one creature physically grips and is mounted upon the other, with no ornamental banding or repeated sign row.
